final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT mt.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS REAL) as ratio, COUNT(*) as track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step1 WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL) SELECT step1.Name, step1.ratio, step1.track_count, step1.ratio - step2.avg_ratio as difference FROM step1, step2 WHERE step1.ratio IS NOT NULL AND step2.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND step1.ratio > step2.avg_ratio
